title: Zoe hero
description: A full-bleed photo hero with a soft dark scrim: a big two-line white semibold headline and a one-line promise, centred at the top on phones and sitting left and vertically centred on desktop, with a yellow CTA centred near the bottom. 4:5 on phones, 2:1 on desktop.
notes: the photo slot is cropped like object-fit: cover; text sits on it in the background colour (foreground in dark mode)
height follows the photo's aspect, not the window, like the original
